🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Zeit (Time)

der Tag = day
der Montag = Monday
der Sonntag = Sunday
das Wochenende = weekend
der Morgen = morning
der Abend = evening

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
